plugins.name: windows-desktop
plugins.description: One-script GlazeWM + YASB tiling desktop setup for Windows, with a troubleshooting guide.

plugins.name: review-agents
plugins.description: Seven read-only reviewer agents: code review, secret auditing, research fact-checking, argument-chain auditing, code-evidence verification, pre-send deliverable checks and silent-automation hunting.

plugins.name: agent-governance
plugins.description: A registry of already-settled rules, decisions and stances that AI agents must not re-litigate — with mechanical audit gates

plugins.name: release-hygiene
plugins.description: Pre-release scan for numeric fingerprints of private facts — areas, counts, dimensions, coordinates, derived ratios — that secret scanners and denylists miss

plugins.name: skill-quality
plugins.description: Adversarial stress-test loop for improving a skill, plus a blind judge that grades pure-prompt skill outputs.

plugins.name: research-methods
plugins.description: Research workflows: loop-until-dry research, how experts in a field actually do something, benchmarking open-source projects against your own, and deciding whether to build an agent and how to organise agent teams.

plugins.name: geo-review
plugins.description: Read-only reviewer that checks geospatial and engineering results (CRS, units, time base, real data coverage, magnitude sanity, silent data loss) before delivery.

plugins.name: reading-tools
plugins.description: A reading mentor that picks what to read next from a domain map and checks it with closed-book retellings.
